title: The Line Set: Holding Instruments Apart
description: A thin reader that declares what a set of small evaluative instruments is, reads whichever sibling packages are installed, and checks one narrow property: that no two of them have given the same spelling to different things. It adds no instrument of its own and computes no aggregate; a legible reading says only that the declared vocabularies did not overlap.
